content:
# 4 Ezra Chapter 13 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Latin Vulgate (Codex Sangermanensis) | **Section:** Core apocalypse — Man from the Sea (Messiah)

---

**13:1** And-it-came-to-pass after-seven-days I-dreamed-a-dream by-night;

**13:2** and-behold! a-wind-arose-from-the-sea and-troubled-all-its-waves.

**13:3** And-I-saw, and-behold! there-came-out-of-the-heart-of-the-sea as-the-form-of-a-man, and-I-saw that-this-man-flew-with-the-clouds-of-heaven;

**13:4** and-wherever-he-turned-his-face-to-look, everything-seen-by-him-trembled, and-whenever-his-voice-was-uttered-out-of-his-mouth, all-those-who-heard-his-voice-melted-away, as-the-wax-melts-when-it-feels-the-fire.

**13:5** And-after-this-I-saw, and-behold! there-was-gathered-together-to-him-an-innumerable-multitude-of-men-from-the-four-winds-of-heaven, to-make-war-against-the-man-that-came-up-out-of-the-sea.

**13:6** And-I-saw, and-behold! he-carved-out-for-himself-a-great-mountain, and-flew-up-upon-it.

**13:7** And-I-sought-to-see-the-region-or-place-from-whence-the-mountain-was-cut-out, and-I-could-not.

**13:8** After-this-I-saw, and-behold! all-those-who-had-gathered-together-to-fight-against-him-were-much-afraid, and-yet-they-dared-to-fight.

**13:9** And-behold, as-he-saw-the-assault-of-the-multitude-as-they-came, he-neither-lifted-his-hand nor-held-a-spear nor-any-weapon-of-war;

**13:10** but-I-saw-only-that-he-sent-out-of-his-mouth-as-it-were-a-stream-of-fire, and-out-of-his-lips-a-flaming-breath, and-out-of-his-tongue-he-sent-out-sparks-and-tempests.

**13:11** And-all-these-were-mingled-together — the-stream-of-fire, the-flaming-breath, and-the-great-tempest — and-they-fell-upon-the-assault-of-the-multitude-which-was-prepared-to-fight, and-burned-them-all-up, so-that-suddenly-nothing-was-seen-of-the-innumerable-multitude but-only-dust-and-ashes-and-smell-of-smoke; and-I-saw-this and-was-astonished.

**13:12** After-this-I-saw-the-same-man-come-down-from-the-mountain, and-call-to-himself-another-multitude-which-was-peaceable.

**13:13** And-there-came-to-him-many-men, some-of-them-joyful-and-others-sorrowful; and-some-of-them-were-bound, and-some-were-bringing-of-those-who-were-offered; and-I-awoke-for-great-fear; and-I-prayed-to-the-Most-High, and-said:

**13:14** You-have-shown-me-these-things-from-the-beginning, and-have-counted-me-worthy; and-I-have-besought-you-that-my-prayer-might-come-before-you.

**13:15** Show-me now-also the-interpretation-of-this-dream.

**13:16** For-as-I-think-in-my-mind concerning-it, woe-to-those-who-shall-be-left-in-those-days! and-much-more-woe-to-those-who-are-not-left!

**13:17** For-those-who-are-not-left-shall-be-in-sorrow,

**13:18** [understanding]-what-things-are-laid-up-in-the-last-days, but-not-attaining-to-them.

**13:19** But-woe-also-to-those-who-are-left, for-this-reason: they-shall-see-great-perils-and-many-necessities, as-these-dreams-show.

**13:20** Yet-is-it-better-to-come-into-them, though-in-peril, than-to-pass-from-the-world-as-a-cloud, and-not-to-see-what-shall-happen-in-the-last-days.

**13:21** And-he-answered-me and-said: I-will-tell-you-the-interpretation-of-the-vision, and-I-will-also-open-to-you-the-things-of-which-you-asked.

**13:22** You-have-asked-about-those-who-are-left; this-is-the-interpretation:

**13:23** He-that-shall-endure-the-peril-in-that-time-shall-keep-those-who-have-fallen-into-danger, even-those-who-have-works-and-have-faith-toward-the-Almighty.

**13:24** Know-therefore-that-those-who-are-left-are-more-blessed-than-those-who-have-died.

**13:25** These-are-the-interpretations-of-the-vision: As-for-what-you-saw — the-man-coming-up-out-of-the-heart-of-the-sea:

**13:26** this-is-he-whom-the-Most-High-is-keeping-many-ages, who-shall-himself-deliver-his-creation; and-he-shall-direct-those-who-are-left.

**13:27** And-as-for-you-having-seen-as-it-were-wind-and-fire-and-storm-coming-out-of-his-mouth, and-as-for-his-not-holding-a-spear-or-weapon-of-war, yet-destroying-the-multitude-that-came-to-fight-him:

**13:28** this-is-the-interpretation: Behold, the-days-come when-the-Most-High-shall-begin-to-deliver-those-who-are-upon-the-earth,

**13:29** and-there-shall-come-upon-the-inhabitants-of-the-earth a-stupor,

**13:30** and-they-shall-plan-to-make-war-one-against-another, city-against-city, place-against-place, people-against-people, and-kingdom-against-kingdom.

**13:31** And-it-shall-be-when-these-things-come-to-pass, and-all-the-signs-shall-occur-which-I-showed-you-before, then-shall-my-son-be-revealed, whom-you-saw-as-a-man-ascending.

**13:32** And-it-shall-be, when-all-the-nations-hear-his-voice, every-man-shall-leave-his-own-land-and-the-warfare-that-they-have-one-against-another;

**13:33** and-an-innumerable-multitude-shall-be-gathered-together-as-you-saw, desiring-to-come-and-fight-against-him.

**13:34** But-he-shall-stand-upon-the-top-of-mount-Zion.

**13:35** And-Zion-shall-come-and-be-made-manifest-to-all-men, prepared-and-built — as-you-saw-the-mountain-carved-out-without-hands.

**13:36** And-this-my-son-shall-rebuke-the-assembled-nations-for-their-ungodliness — this-was-symbolized-by-the-tempest —

**13:37** and-shall-taunt-them-to-their-face-with-their-evil-thoughts, and-the-torments-with-which-they-are-to-be-tormented — which-were-symbolized-by-the-flames —

**13:38** and-he-shall-destroy-them-without-labor-by-the-law — which-was-symbolized-by-the-fire.

**13:39** And-as-for-you-having-seen-him-gather-to-himself-another-multitude-that-was-peaceable:

**13:40** these-are-the-ten-tribes-which-were-carried-away-from-their-own-land-in-the-days-of-Hoshea-the-king — whom-Shalmaneser-the-king-of-the-Assyrians-led-captive, and-he-carried-them-across-the-river, and-they-were-carried-into-another-land.

**13:41** But-they-took-counsel-among-themselves-that-they-would-leave-the-multitude-of-the-nations, and-go-forth-into-a-further-country-where-never-mankind-dwelt,

**13:42** that-they-might-there-keep-their-statutes-which-they-had-not-kept-in-their-own-land.

**13:43** And-they-went-in-by-the-narrow-passages-of-the-river-Euphrates.

**13:44** For-the-Most-High-then-wrought-wonders-for-them, and-held-back-the-springs-of-the-river-until-they-had-passed-over.

**13:45** For-through-that-country-there-was-a-great-way-to-go — namely, of-a-year-and-a-half; and-the-same-region-is-called-Arsareth.

**13:46** Then-they-dwelt-there-until-the-last-time; and-now-when-they-begin-to-come-again,

**13:47** the-Most-High-shall-hold-back-again-the-springs-of-the-river, that-they-may-be-able-to-pass-over; therefore-you-saw-the-multitude-gathered-together-with-peace.

**13:48** But-those-who-are-left-of-your-people shall-also-be-left — those-within-my-holy-borders.

**13:49** Therefore-when-he-shall-destroy-the-multitude-of-the-nations-that-are-gathered-together, he-shall-defend-the-people-that-remain.

**13:50** And-then-he-shall-show-them-very-many-wonders.

**13:51** Then-I-said: O-LORD, my-lord, show-me-this: why-have-I-seen-the-man-coming-up-from-the-heart-of-the-sea?

**13:52** And-he-said-to-me: Just-as-no-one-can-explore-or-know-what-is-in-the-depths-of-the-sea, so-no-one-on-earth-can-see-my-son, or-those-who-are-with-him, except-in-the-time-of-his-day.

**13:53** This-is-the-interpretation-of-the-dream-which-you-saw. And-you-alone-have-been-enlightened-herein,

**13:54** because-you-have-forsaken-your-own-ways and-have-occupied-yourself-with-mine, and-have-searched-out-my-law;

**13:55** for-you-have-ordered-your-life-in-wisdom, and-you-have-called-understanding-your-mother.

**13:56** Therefore-have-I-shown-you-this; for-there-is-a-reward-laid-up-with-the-Most-High: and-it-shall-be-that-after-three-more-days-I-will-speak-other-things-to-you, and-declare-to-you-mighty-and-wondrous-things.

**13:57** Then-I-arose and-walked-in-the-field, giving-great-glory-and-praise-to-the-Most-High-for-his-wonders, which-he-does-from-time-to-time,

**13:58** and-because-he-governs-the-times-and-such-things-as-fall-in-their-seasons. And-there-I-tarried-three-days.
